# Rise Up Roofing & Construction

> Dual-licensed San Diego County roofing and Class B general building contractor (`CSLB #1096492`) and Owens Corning Preferred Contractor (`#247226`). Headquartered in Oceanside, CA, serving 30 San Diego County communities plus Temecula and Murrieta with residential roof replacement, concrete/clay tile underlayment relays, 24/7 emergency leak repair, in-house solar detach-and-reset, commercial flat roofing, and exterior construction.

Rise Up Roofing & Construction Inc. (owners Edith & Luis) operates with a 100% in-house, zero-subcontractor installation protocol, full California Residential Code `CRC R908` bare-deck tear-off compliance, California `Title 24` Part 6 Cool Roof compliance (Climate Zones 7 & 10), `$2M+` General Liability and Workers' Compensation coverage, and non-prorated manufacturer system warranties up to 25 years. Property owners can get an instant 10-second ballpark estimate online or schedule a complimentary drone and attic diagnostic inspection.

## Business & Entity Facts

- **Legal & Brand Name**: Rise Up Roofing & Construction (`Rise Up Roofing & Construction Inc.`)
- **Headquarters**: 2182 S El Camino Real, Oceanside, CA 92054
- **Phone**: (760) 622-1230
- **Email**: info@riseuprac.com
- **Website**: https://riseuprac.com
- **Contractor Licenses**: California Contractors State License Board (`CSLB #1096492`) — Dual-licensed `C-39 Roofing` & `Class B General Building`
- **Certifications & Affiliations**: Owens Corning Preferred Contractor (`#247226`), Tile Roofing Industry Alliance, Escondido Chamber of Commerce (`#9925`), `$2M+` General Liability & Workers' Comp Insured
- **Office & Dispatch Hours**: Mon–Fri 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM, Sat 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM; 24/7 Emergency Leak & Storm Dispatch (60–90 minute response)
- **Service Footprint**: 32 indexed communities across San Diego County (30 cities/communities) and South Riverside County (`Temecula` & `Murrieta`). Note: No Orange County coverage.

## Core Services (16 Pages)

- [Roof Inspection & Diagnostics](https://riseuprac.com/services/roof-inspection): Complimentary residential 4K aerial drone surveys, FLIR thermal attic moisture tracing, and certified real estate escrow roof reports.
- [Residential Roofing](https://riseuprac.com/services/residential): Complete CRC R908 tear-off roof replacements, Owens Corning Duration® SureNail® architectural shingles, and Title 24 cool-roof systems.
- [Roof Leak Repair & Emergency Service](https://riseuprac.com/services/roof-repair): 24/7 rapid 60–90 minute storm leak dispatch, OSHA ridge-wrapped tarping, FLIR leak tracing, valley/flashing restoration, and insurance photo documentation.
- [Tile Roofing Installation & Relay](https://riseuprac.com/services/tile-roofing): Concrete and Spanish clay tile lift-and-reset (underlayment relay) with dual-ply 250°F synthetic membranes—saving ~40%–55% vs. full tile replacement.
- [Metal Roofing Installation & Repair](https://riseuprac.com/services/metal-roofing): Non-combustible Class-A WUI wildfire-rated standing seam architectural metal and stone-coated steel roofing.
- [Solar Roofing & Integration](https://riseuprac.com/services/solar-roofing): Turnkey in-house solar panel detach-and-reset during reroofing with engineered waterproof stanchion flashings, plus integrated solar roof installs.
- [Commercial Roofing](https://riseuprac.com/services/commercial-roofing): Single-ply TPO/PVC membranes, NDL manufacturer warranties, commercial flat roof replacements, and HOA multi-family roofing.
- [Commercial Roof Inspection](https://riseuprac.com/services/commercial-roof-inspection): Infrared moisture surveys, core cut analysis, CapEx reserve lifecycle reports, and commercial acquisition due diligence.
- [Industrial Roofing Services](https://riseuprac.com/services/industrial-roofing): Heavy-duty warehouse, manufacturing plant, and logistics facility 80-mil TPO and structural deck retrofits.
- [Modified Bitumen & Built-Up Roofing](https://riseuprac.com/services/modified-bitumen): Multi-ply BUR, SBS/APP modified bitumen, and cold-applied low-slope waterproofing assemblies.
- [Roof Coating & Commercial Restoration](https://riseuprac.com/services/roof-coating): Seamless Title 24 high-SRI elastomeric silicone and acrylic flat roof restorations that extend membrane life 15–20 years.
- [General Construction](https://riseuprac.com/services/construction): Dual-licensed Class B structural dry-rot framing, fascia/rafter remediation, custom patio covers, and exterior remodeling.
- [Custom Home & Room Additions](https://riseuprac.com/services/home-additions): Second-story expansions, primary suite additions, structural engineering, permits, and roofline tie-ins.
- [ADU Construction Contractors](https://riseuprac.com/services/adu-construction): Turnkey detached backyard ADUs, garage conversions, and permitted California accessory dwelling units.
- [Siding Installation & Replacement](https://riseuprac.com/services/siding): James Hardie® fiber cement, WUI fire-rated exterior cladding, stucco/wood rot remediation, and weather-resistive barriers.
- [Custom Deck Builder & Balconies](https://riseuprac.com/services/deck-builder): Engineered Trex® composite decks, hillside caisson view decks, waterproof walk-decks, and marine-grade cable railings.

## Engineering & Cost Guides (9 Technical Guides)

- [Guides Knowledge Hub](https://riseuprac.com/guides): Complete index of practitioner-written San Diego roofing and construction guides.
- [Tile Roof Relay vs Replacement: The Complete San Diego Guide](https://riseuprac.com/guides/tile-roof-relay-vs-replacement): Underlayment lifespan math, lift-and-reset workflow, and 40%–55% cost savings vs. new tile.
- [Coastal Tile Roof Underlayment: Why 20-Year Leaks Happen & How to Fix Them](https://riseuprac.com/guides/coastal-tile-roof-underlayment-lifespan): Marine-layer salt corrosion, copper/stainless flashings, and Oceanside/Carlsbad tile relay specs.
- [California Title 24 Cool Roof Requirements: Compliance Guide for San Diego](https://riseuprac.com/guides/california-title-24-cool-roof-guide): Climate Zone 7 & 10 aged solar reflectance, thermal emittance, SRI thresholds, and city permitting.
- [Emergency Roof Leak Triage in San Diego: First 60 Minutes Protocol](https://riseuprac.com/guides/emergency-roof-leak-triage-san-diego): Interior containment, OSHA storm tarping, FLIR moisture mapping, and insurance claim documentation.
- [Commercial Flat Roof Solutions: TPO, PVC & Silicone Coatings Compared](https://riseuprac.com/guides/commercial-flat-roof-solutions): Low-slope membrane selection, ponding water resistance, and commercial lifecycle costs.
- [Commercial TPO vs PVC Roofing in San Diego: The Engineering Comparison](https://riseuprac.com/guides/commercial-tpo-vs-pvc-roofing-san-diego): Heat-welded seam strength, chemical/grease resistance for restaurants vs. warehouses, and Title 24 compliance.
- [What is Built-Up Roofing (BUR)? Lifespan, Layers & Repair in San Diego](https://riseuprac.com/guides/what-is-built-up-roofing-bur): Multi-ply asphalt/gravel flat roof diagnostics, blistering repairs, and modern modified-bitumen or silicone retrofits.
- [San Diego Home Remodeling & Addition Costs: 2026 Price & Permitting Guide](https://riseuprac.com/guides/home-remodeling-costs-san-diego): Square-foot budgeting, structural tie-ins, municipal plan check timelines, and Class B construction scopes.
- [Deck Building in Rancho San Diego: County Permits, WUI Fire Codes & Trex](https://riseuprac.com/guides/rancho-san-diego-deck-building-permits-materials): Wildland-Urban Interface ignition-resistant framing, hillside footings, and composite deck engineering.
